title.zh: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
title.en: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast

current_state.zh: Russia's digital ruble attracted more than 220,000 accounts in its first month after the Sept. 1 launch, nearly quadruple the central bank's 60,000 forecast, as BRICS members explore linking their CBDCs for cross-border trade and payments.
current_state.en: Russia's digital ruble attracted more than 220,000 accounts in its first month after the Sept. 1 launch, nearly quadruple the central bank's 60,000 forecast, as BRICS members explore linking their CBDCs for cross-border trade and payments.
